name: Churn Palm
description: Strike with a palm that takes the churn of the opponent's qi and lands it back even.

name: Churn Ward
description: Hold a ward of still qi at the center of a wild churn so that nothing shakes it.

name: Frenzy Step
description: Step through the churn of a crowd along the one calm line the motion leaves.

name: Chaos Cancel
description: Meet a wild technique with an exactly opposed pulse and cancel its erratic force.

name: Frenzy Settling
description: Lay a settling hand on a frenzied foe and bring his racing qi back to a standstill.

name: Harmonic Mend
description: Bring the broken rhythm of an injured ally's qi back into step so the wound can close.

name: Turbulence Stilling
description: Still a whole field of tumult at once by laying an exact opposite beneath every motion in it.

name: Eddy Accord
description: Bring the eddies of a battle into accord about the user so that they shield and unsettle foes.

name: Maelstrom Stillpoint
description: Stand at the still point of a maelstrom and draw all its force into the body to press the foes down.

name: Poised Tumult
description: streams: Balance + Chaos; hold the chaos stream at the center of the balance stream so frenzy rules itself into stillness.

name: Sap Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a rising sap and an even weight into the point of impact.

name: Sap Ward
description: Hold a ward of living qi that gives with a blow and rights itself at once.

name: Sap Glide
description: Glide on the slow pull of living qi that keeps the body upright through each step.

name: Seed Cast
description: Cast a seed of qi that sprouts into a thorny lash on the target's arm.

name: Verdant Mend
description: Raise the living force of an ally's wound to the level of his sound flesh and close it.

name: Bloom Rinse
description: Bloom clean life through an ally's body to push out poison and the slow rot of decay.

name: Sap Hold
description: Wind living vines of even strength round the opponent's limbs and hold him still.

name: Vital Parry
description: Meet a strike with a springing arm that gives and then bears it aside.

name: Blooming Accord
description: Bring all near allies into one accord of living strength that mends them and evens their power.

name: Equal Growth
description: Cut back the rank growth of the foes' qi and the field to the level of the user's own.

name: Evergreen Veil
description: Draw an evergreen veil round the allies that turns blows and keeps their wounds from worsening.

name: Vital Equilibrium
description: Draw the surplus force of hostile strikes into the body and give it to the wounded as life.

name: Living Equipoise
description: streams: Balance + Life; set life and death level for a breath and bring back one whose breath has just stopped.
